8823-dutch-life-in-town-and-country.title: Dutch Life in Town and Country
8823-dutch-life-in-town-and-country.creator: P. M. Hough, B.A.
8823-dutch-life-in-town-and-country.description: A book by P. M. Hough, B.A.. There is in human affairs a reason for everything we see, although not always reason in everything. It is the part of the historian to seek in the archives of a nation the reasons for the facts of common experience and observation, it is the part of the philosopher to moralize upon antecedent causes and present results.

arxiv-2101-11391.title: Self-Calibrating Active Binocular Vision via Active Efficient Coding with Deep Autoencoders
arxiv-2101-11391.creator: Charles Wilmot, Bertram E. Shi, Jochen Triesch
arxiv-2101-11391.description: Abstract We present a model of the self-calibration of active binocular vision comprising the simultaneous learning of visual representations, vergence, and pursuit eye movements. The model follows the principle of Active Efficient Coding (AEC), a recent extension of the classic Efficient Coding Hypothesis to active perception.

arxiv-2108-10304.title: Resonant superalgebras for supergravity
arxiv-2108-10304.creator: Remigiusz Durka, Krzysztof M. Graczyk
arxiv-2108-10304.description: Abstract Considering supergravity theory is a natural step in the development of gravity models. This paper follows the “algebraic“ path and constructs possible extensions of the Poincaré and Anti-de-Sitter algebras, which inherit their basic commutation structure. Previously achieved results of this type are fragmentary and show only a limited fraction of possible algebraic realizations.

arxiv-2404-00058.title: Multiscale physics of atomic nuclei from first principles
arxiv-2404-00058.creator: Z. H. Sun, A. Ekström, C. Forssén, G. Hagen, G. R. Jansen, T. Papenbrock
arxiv-2404-00058.description: Abstract Atomic nuclei exhibit multiple energy scales ranging from hundreds of MeV in binding energies to fractions of an MeV for low-lying collective excitations. As the limits of nuclear binding is approached near the neutron- and proton driplines, traditional shell-structure starts to melt with an onset of deformation and an emergence of coexisting shapes.

arxiv-2410-14085.creator: Toshiyuki Katsura, Shigeyuki Kondō, Matthias Schütt
arxiv-2410-14085.description: Abstract . We show that K3 surfaces in characteristic 2 can admit sets of n n disjoint smooth rational curves whose sum is divisible by 2 in the Picard group, for each n = 8 , 12 , 16 , 20 n=8,12,16,20 .

britannica-1911-rothschild.title: Rothschild (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-rothschild.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-rothschild.description: Article 'Rothschild' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. acquired an unexampled position from the magnitude of its financial transactions. The original name was Bauer, the founder of the house being Mayer Anselm (1743–1812), the son of Anselm Moses Bauer, a small Jewish merchant of Frankfort-on-the-Main. His father wished him to become a rabbi, but he set up as a money-lender at the sign of the “Red Shield” (Rothschild) in the Frankfort Judengasse.

pmc-11326704.title: The use of quantitative clinical pharmacology approaches to support moxidectin dosing recommendations in lactation
pmc-11326704.creator: Nolan D. Wood, Danelle Smith, Sally A. Kinrade, Mark T. Sullivan, Craig R. Rayner, David Wesche, Kashyap Patel, Karen Rowland-Yeo
pmc-11326704.description: Moxidectin is approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (US FDA) for the treatment of onchocerciasis (river-blindness) due to Onchocerca volvulus in patients aged 12 years and older. In onchocerciasis-endemic areas, mass drug administration (MDA) programs with ivermectin, with or without vector control, aim to control the disease, reduce morbidity, interrupt transmission, and more recently, achieve elimination.

pmc-11483748.title: Factors That Influence Access to Medical Assistance in Dying Services: An Integrative Review
pmc-11483748.creator: Jayne Hewitt, Michael Wilson, Ann Bonner, Melissa J Bloomer
pmc-11483748.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundIn nearly all jurisdictions where it is permitted, Medical Assistance in Dying is situated in a healthcare system. Currently, limited evidence demonstrates how supply and demand factors influence access to Medical Assistance in Dying.ObjectiveThe aim of this study is to synthesise empirical research from jurisdictions where Medical Assistance in Dying is legal to identify how supply and demand factors influence access for eligible adults.MethodAn integrative review was conducted.

pmc-12553073.title: Effects of dietary supplementation with selenium in organic form and iodine in dairy goats and their transfer to milk and dairy products
pmc-12553073.creator: I Azorín, J Madrid, S Martínez-Miró, MB López, M López, F Hernández
pmc-12553073.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Highlights•High-dose organic selenium plus iodine in goats enriched milk.•With high dietary iodine, milk, cheese, and yogurt qualified as “high in iodine”.•High organic selenium made fresh cheese eligible as a “selenium source”.•Lower iodine doses may still deliver meaningful mineral enrichment.Keywords: Small ruminants, Feed additives, Milk, Dairy products

Introduction

Mineral supplementation of the diets of dairy goats is widely adopted in intensive production systems to promote animal health and prevent disease (Simões et al., 2021).

pmc-12645602.title: Sociodemographic and geographical variation in prescribing psychotropic drugs to children and young people with common mental disorders and Attention Deficit Hyperactive Disorders in North West London: population-based study
pmc-12645602.creator: Antonio Ivan Lazzarino, Stephen Russell Naulls, Rinad Bakhti, Steven Hope, Dasha Nicholls, Michaela Otis, Tamsin Robinson, Shamini Gnani, Dougal S Hargreaves
pmc-12645602.description: ObjectivesTo estimate the sociodemographic and geographical variation in prescribing selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) and medications for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) to children and young people (CYP) in North West London, UK.DesignCross-sectional population-based study.SettingGeneral practices in North West London, UK, with data for the period 2020–2022 obtained from the Discover Now platform, which covers approximately 95% of the local population.

pmc-13266239.title: Humidity-driven lactose crystallization on milk powders: a surface-level study
pmc-13266239.creator: Jennifer Burgain, Elise Germain, Ummuhani Ugur, Serafim Bakalis, Mogens Andersen, Anni Bygvrå Hougaard, Alireza Naseri, Kirsten Gade Malmos, Claire Gaiani
pmc-13266239.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study introduces in-situ atomic force microscopy (AFM) under controlled humidity ramps as a novel approach for real-time monitoring dairy powder surface evolution. Applied to skim milk powder (SMP) and whole milk powder (WMP) as case-study matrices, the method was combined with dynamic vapor sorption (DVS), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), and powder rheology to provide a multi-scale characterization of humidity surface changes.

pmc-13291453.title: Association Between GLP-1RAs and Postoperative Complications Following Operative Ankle Fracture Fixation: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13291453.creator: Shawn K. Monteiro, Nabeel A. Khatri, Deen B. Sari, Christopher Sanford
pmc-13291453.description: Background:Ankle fractures occur at an estimated rate of 4.22 per 10 000 person-years, occurring most frequently within the 21- to 30-year-old demographic. This retrospective cohort study used the TriNetX research network to evaluate the association between perioperative glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA) use and postoperative complications following operative ankle fixation.

pmc-13560944.title: Determinants of Epithelial Healing Time and Cumulative Risk-Factor Burden in Eyes with Delayed Corneal Epithelialization After Routine Keratoplasty
pmc-13560944.creator: Dania Mohammed Jamal, Doaa Sofyan Milibari, Muhammad Ali Ahad
pmc-13560944.description: BackgroundDelayed epithelialization is a common complication after keratoplasty that can compromise graft survival and increase the economic burden.PurposeTo identify donor and recipient factors linked to extended epithelial healing time in eyes with delayed epithelialization after routine penetrating and lamellar keratoplasty.
